deduplicated_dataset.evaluation_population: Perceptual-deduplicated matched images with successful inference, adjudicated_gradable=1, and valid grade 0..4; original full-dataset labels and model probabilities were not changed.
deduplicated_dataset.exclusions: Unmatched label rows are excluded; ungradable rows and unsuccessful inferences are excluded from grade metrics.
deduplicated_dataset.label_mapping: Messidor-2 adjudicated five-point ICDR grade 0..4 mapped 1:1 to the existing APTOS output labels defined in the downloaded label readme.

referable_dr_grade_2_or_worse.rule: true and predicted referable if grade >= 2

full_dataset.evaluation_population: Matched Messidor-2 images with successful inference, adjudicated_gradable=1, and valid adjudicated_dr_grade 0..4; four unmatched label records excluded.
full_dataset.exclusions: Unmatched label rows are excluded; ungradable rows and unsuccessful inferences are excluded from grade metrics.
full_dataset.label_mapping: Messidor-2 adjudicated five-point ICDR grade 0..4 mapped 1:1 to the existing APTOS output labels defined in the downloaded label readme.

referable_dr_grade_2_or_worse.rule: true and predicted referable if grade >= 2

interpretation: The deduplicated result is a sensitivity analysis. It does not replace the original full-dataset evaluation and does not establish clinical generalization.
label_provenance_statement: The Messidor-2 official release does not provide official DR ground truth. This evaluation uses separately acquired third-party reference labels.

material_conclusion_assessment.rationale: Only six of 1,744 evaluated records were excluded and the reported point-estimate deltas remain below 0.001 for the listed metrics. The conflicting-label perceptual group is retained in the full result and makes this a sensitivity analysis, not a corrected benchmark.
